transcript: Listen to this. Hey Grok, move my car out of the driveway, okay? Sure. Moving your Tesla now to the front of the street. Tesla just turned your car into a robot assistant, and you can control it with your voice. Your Tesla is now parked at the front. Yeah, it is insane. Tesla has officially launched Grok Bot inside its cars. Now, this isn't just another chatbot sitting on your dashboard. You can actually give Grok a job, and it can go and do it for you. Through its connectors, Grok can work with things like your email and calendar, and you can use it for things like booking appointments, reservations, and even ordering things online. But here's where this gets really interesting. Grok knows you're inside a Tesla, so it can combine what you ask for with your car's location and your route. Imagine getting into your Tesla and saying, "I'm running late. Find me a coffee shop on my route and order me a cappuccino." Grok places the order while your Tesla drives you there. So by the time you arrive, your coffee is already waiting for you. Or imagine this scenario. You can tell your car, "I'm going to be 20 minutes late for my meeting. Let them know and move it to tomorrow afternoon." You aren't opening five different apps. You're just telling an AI what you want and letting it figure out the steps, from checking your calendar to sending the message. And that's the real shift. AI is starting to get a physical body, and a car is one of the most interesting places to start with. Before you get excited, there's one thing you need to know. The advanced multi-step actions currently require a SuperGrok Heavy subscription, but basic connectors can be used by anyone right now. Your Tesla just became your personal AI agent on wheels. Maybe this is what robots of the future look like. Honestly, Elon merging tech from his different companies is so exciting to me. What else would you do with this technology?
